case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 812 of 2023; Criminal Appeal No. 816 of 2023; Criminal Appeal No. 813 of 2023

parties.respondent: State of Uttar Pradesh and Another

summary: Bail granted by High Court in serious criminal case involving murder and related charges; failure to consider gravity, motive, specific allegations, and unlawful assembly; no cogent reasons provided by High Court; overcrowding not valid ground; bail cancellation upheld; accused directed to surrender; appeals allowed.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned bail orders quashed and set aside; accused directed to surrender forthwith or be taken into custody.
